reason: Most of my customers order and pay at the counter while I'm standing right there, so paying by QR at the table doesn't fix anything for me. My regulars already follow me on Instagram and WhatsApp, and I message them there for free.
objection: I already pay for Wox/SQR and a card terminal, and I check the totals myself every night. Another system means another payout to reconcile, and my staff learning something new for a handful of bills.
would_change_my_mind: If the per-transaction fee in writing came in clearly lower than my card terminal, so switching saves me money every month instead of adding a subscription.
